title: The 5% Outside Metric Still Creates Dangerous Conversion Traps
hook: Only 5% live outside metric, but one conversion emptied a plane.
closing: Unit checks feel tedious until one conversion turns ordinary work into an emergency.
question: Should every country use metric?

segments.say: Only 5% live in non-metric countries. A tiny holdout still creates dangerous conversion points.
A metric mix-up dropped the Mars orbiter to 57 kilometers. The spacecraft flew far below its planned path.
A metric error left the plane 55% short on fuel. It ran dry and had to glide down.
